karnataka_thalassemia_chelation.claim: Across 43493 facility-level monitoring snapshots of Deferoxamine statewide, the pipeline flagged 100% as high/critical risk -- including 100% of snapshots dated on or before the real 2 October 2023 Deccan Herald report confirming the shortage was still unresolved. Unlike a single-admission-date crisis, this drug's correct signature is a PERSISTENT critical flag, not a one-time early warning; the pipeline reproduces that shape rather than a temporary dip.
